jobs.label: SQUIRREL MEAT
jobs.design: Exactly TWO compact lean meat morsels as one rigid loose pair, visually distinct from the longer rabbit saddle portions. Each is a small thick rounded triangular nugget, not a thin slice: deep rosy-red meat with broad polished facets and no bones, no cream rim, no longitudinal stripes. The slightly larger nugget sits at the LEFT in FRONT0, the smaller sits at RIGHT with a narrow visible gap; their centers lie along the resource's left-right axis. The larger LEFT nugget alone has ONE tiny flat oval cream speck at its upper FRONT edge. Smaller nugget is plain. Both have a softly flattened base and softly domed top, same proportions and gap in all8 views. Orbit the entire TWO-piece arrangement together.0 largerLEFT/smallerRIGHT;45 smaller near lowerRIGHT/larger far upperLEFT;90 smaller nearest and partly occluding larger behind;135 smaller near lowerLEFT/larger far upperRIGHT;180 smallerLEFT/largerRIGHT, cream speck on far side hidden;225 larger near lowerRIGHT/smaller far upperLEFT, speck hidden;270 larger nearest partially occluding smaller behind;315 larger near lowerLEFT/smaller far upperRIGHT, speck visible. jobs.label: WILD BEAR MEAT
jobs.design: ONE broad, fatty rectangular rib-cut pickup, gently curved and softly beveled, about twice as long LEFT-to-RIGHT as front-to-rear width, quite thick. Burgundy-red broad muscle planes and one broad smooth ivory fat cap over the REAR half of the top face. Exactly THREE short blunt ivory rib tips project just a little from the FRONT long edge at equal spacing; no skeletal rack, no long bones, no gore. The rib tips are rounded small rectangular nubs integrated into one red meat slab, and their arrangement is fixed. LEFT end is squared-round; RIGHT end has ONE slightly clipped upper corner. The cream top cap has one small red notch near LEFT end, a stable landmark. FRONT0 shows three front rib tips, left rounded end/right clipped end.45 sees clipped RIGHT end near lowerRIGHT, rib tips along foregroundLEFT face.90 direct RIGHT narrow end: rib tips are only edge projections on imageLEFT.135 rear-right sees broad smooth rear face and clipped end near lowerLEFT, rib tips largely hidden.180 rear broadface, clipped endLEFT, no rib tips facingcamera.225 rear-left sees rounded LEFT end near lowerRIGHT, broad rear face imageLEFT, tips hidden except edge.270 direct LEFT end, front rib tips at imageRIGHT edge.315 front-left sees rounded LEFT end near lowerLEFT and three front rib tips. Keep exactly one slab, one broad fat cap, three short rib tips, one small cap notch, same geometry in all views. It is an optional wild-animal ART PROPOSAL; no companion animal or animal figure appears.
